correctness.rationale: PASS. Eliminating leaf variables gives the reversible second-order Rule-90 state matrix A=[[x+x^-1,1],[1,0]] over F2[x,x^-1]/(x^n-1). det A=1. Decompose x^n-1=(x^m-1)^(2^a) with odd m, so CRT applies. Away from x+1, eigenvectors (x,1) and (x^-1,1) diagonalize with eigenvalues x and x^-1, giving twice the degree of gcd(x^n-1,x^t-1). At x+1 the local parameter y=x+1 yields s=y^2/x; for B=A+I, ker B has dimension min(2^a,2), and B^2=sA gives 2min(2^a,2^v2(t)) at even t. For odd t the factor 1+A+...+A^(t-1) is a local unit, so the exceptional contribution is 1 at odd n and 2 at even n. Summation gives exactly the parity/gcd exponent, including the n=3 edge boundary. A^L=I and no earlier full fixed space establish exact order, and the largest invariant factor realizes that primitive period; Möbius inversion is correct. Independent GF(2) adjacency-power/rank checks used 280 (n,t) cases for n=3..16 and 1<=t<=2n+1; code inspected from verify.py, but its saved reported 1,200 cases were not substituted for this audit. Nothing about asynchronous updates or spatial symmetry quotients is proved.
